title: Treasury Hosts Liberty University Summit on AI, Energy, and Emerging Technologies
summary: The Treasury Department hosted a summit at Liberty University on April 27, 2026, bringing together students, government officials, and industry leaders to discuss AI, energy, emerging technologies, and financial literacy. The event featured four panels covering frontier AI, energy infrastructure, workforce productivity, and capital access. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chief AI Officer Paras Malik delivered remarks emphasizing U.S. leadership in AI and innovation opportunity.
key_points: Event held April 27, 2026, at Liberty University during Financial Literacy Month
Featured four panels: frontier AI, energy, workforce productivity, and financial literacy
Participants included Treasury officials, White House representatives, Commerce, SBA, and industry leaders
Secretary Bessent stated: 'There has never been a better time to build and innovate in America'
Event was live-streamed for Liberty University participants and Treasury AI Council members
Event reflects Treasury's outreach efforts to engage students on emerging technology topics
